content.scenario: A consumer files a complaint against a company for unfair trade practices in a district. Can the District Collector investigate the complaint?
content.outcome: Yes, the District Collector can investigate the complaint as it falls within his jurisdiction, and he has the authority to do so on a complaint or on a reference made to him by the Central Authority or the Commissioner of a regional office.
